Method of Attack: JavaScript code executed inside browsers to mine cryptocurrencies without user knowledge, delivered via malvertising campaigns on gaming and streaming sites
Impacted Systems: Browsers on users' computers visiting affected websites
Attack Vector: Malicious ads with custom JavaScript code delivered via online advertising companies
Indicators of Compromise: Domains associated with malvertising campaigns mining Monero
JavaScript mining scripts capable of mining Monero, Feathercoin, Litecoin
Malicious ads on Russian and Ukrainian gaming and streaming websites
